== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Quite A Mercenary (Japanese)|Quite A Mercenary]] from [[A New Hope (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://theswca.com/index.php?action=disp_item&item_id=67709 Japanese A New Hope source photograph].

Crop rectangle <code>(17, 2, 465, 622)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>acee7c658495fa1ec4c488525e4e0271612736a49e6669652f3885155bea4c9d</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1997.
